label: team_0080_nelke_02
text: Operation Starfall is going well, wouldn’t you\nsay? Only two bosses left now.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0080_nelke_03
text: This whole experience has been eye-opening,\nto say the least. I’m glad I could take part.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0080_nelke_06
text: Personally, I don’t think Cassiopeia feels any hate\nor resentment toward Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0080_nelke_07
text: No, there must be some other reason behind\nOperation Starfall...\c\nBut what could it be?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0080_nelke_08
text: Well. I’d best get back to keeping watch. Call for\nme if you decide to take on the base, OK?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
